character: vain glossy dark-brown mink, sleek shiny fur, smug expression, always in motion
props: wooden picket fence across snowy yard, stands intact all clip; weasel neighbor gripping pickets close to lens beyond it
motion_rule: mink crosses the frame into a new spot every window, never speaks from one place; camera and shot size change every window (macro/close/mid/waist/low/top down/wide), never same size twice in a row; weasel framed large and close to lens beyond the fence
environment: snowy backyard, bright sunny midday, hard shadows, wooden picket fence

audio.delivery: smug self-satisfied female voice, native Russian stress, calm confident tone
audio.pronunciation: stress: shi-KAR-ny, se-BYA, GLAV-no-ye, sa-SYE-di, za-VEE-do-va-li — the stressed syllable in the last word is VEE, never ZA-vi-do-va-li
audio.pacing: even natural pacing, lines fit their windows with room to spare
audio.lip_sync: her mouth opens and closes clearly on every syllable, lips shaping the words, never a voice-over
audio.sfx: snow crunch under paws, fence creaks as weasel grabs pickets, weasel huffs with envy

timeline.a: mink leaps from a snowbank on the right, slides to yard center
mink strides left along fence, back arching in a wave | weasel leans to pickets, brows rise
mink tumbles over a snowbank, lands against pickets | weasel climbs a picket closer to lens
mink runs a half circle from fence to yard center, tail whips | weasel's jaw drops
mink shakes off snow in a fan, steps toward fence | weasel lurches forward, nearly slips
mink glides along pickets right to left, fur brushing tops | weasel sneers, stretches after her
mink sprints, leaps a snowbank, fur fans mid-air, lands by pickets | weasel grips a picket tight
mink dashes from pickets across yard to a snowdrift on the left | weasel scrabbles along fence chasing her
mink launches off the snowdrift, rolls across snow toward the right edge | weasel reaches through pickets, missing her
mink darts back to fence, skids low through snow | weasel grabs a picket, paws slide down it, drops to the snow
mink bounds over a low snowbank, lands spinning at yard center | weasel scrambles up another picket to follow
mink races along fence toward lens, snow spraying behind | weasel clings to pickets, keeping pace
mink sweeps up to the pickets and swings her flared fur across the lens | weasel in the same frame, face twisting with envy, clinging to the intact fence

must_appear: wooden picket fence intact on snow in every frame; weasel visible close to fence each window; mink and weasel together in frame at 9.3-10.0
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, dusk, evening, lamp, dim, moody, low key, candle, neon, subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, burned-in graphics, static camera, locked-off shots, same shot size twice, a vertical pillar in one place, only her head moving, speaking from one spot, sitting and grooming, the fence breaking apart, a picket torn loose, floating objects, duplicate props, object duplication, extra limbs, multiple characters beyond the two, character changing appearance mid-shot, English speech, foreign accent, Latin letters, any word after 6.3
